data.title: Sintx Technologies: Strong Q3 Beat, Scalable Growth and Upcoming Product Launches Support Unchanged $6 Price Target and Buy Rating
data.description:
Anthony Vendetti, an analyst from Maxim Group, reiterated the Buy rating on Sintx Technologies. The associated price target remains the same with $6.00.

Anthony Vendetti has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, starting with Sintx Technologies’ preliminary third-quarter revenue coming in far above both management guidance and Street expectations, which highlights strong execution on its contract manufacturing backlog and robust demand for its industrial ceramics. He views this outperformance as evidence that the company’s current manufacturing footprint is efficient and scalable, positioning Sintx to convert newly available capacity into further OEM orders and sustain elevated growth through 2027.

In addition, Vendetti points to upcoming product launches—most notably the SiNAPTIC Foot & Ankle Wedge System and later-stage 3D-printed, patient-specific implants and antipathogenic solutions—as key future revenue drivers that should shift the mix toward higher-value medical applications. He also notes that the expected warrant exercises strengthen Sintx’s capital position, extending its runway into 2027, and that the stock trades at a discount to peers on EV/revenue despite attractive long-term platform potential, supporting his unchanged $6 price target and Buy recommendation.
